PUBLISH.summary: Posts a message to a channel.
PUBLISH.complexity: O(N+M) where N is the number of clients subscribed to the receiving channel and M is the total number of subscribed patterns (by any client).

reply_schema.description: The number of clients that received the message. Note that in a Cluster, only clients that are connected to the same node as the publishing client are included in the count. In cluster mode, the combined channel and message payload is limited to 16,774,952 bytes by the 16 MiB cluster-bus packet limit. A larger payload returns an error and is not delivered locally or remotely.
